ontology.description: Local Palantir-style CRM ontology for learning. Not a Palantir artifact.

objectType.description: A person who owns leads, accounts and opportunities.

salesRepId.description: Same value as the user ID.

openLeadCount.description: Guard counter. Every lead assignment and conversion writes it, so concurrent assignments conflict (report section 8.4).

objectType.description: A company that is a customer or a possible customer.

annualRevenue.description: Currency USD. JSON-encoded as a string.

objectType.description: A possible customer that nobody has qualified yet.

ownerId.description: Foreign key to SalesRep. Empty until assigned.

convertedAccountId.description: Foreign key to Account. Set by convert-lead.

objectType.description: A possible sale. Two datasources: the CRM table and the e-signature system, joined column-wise on opportunityId.

stage.description: prospecting | qualification | proposal | negotiation | closedWon | closedLost

amount.description: Currency USD. JSON-encoded as a string.

probability.description: A represented estimate between 0 and 1, not a fact about the customer (report section 4.3).

contractSigned.description: From the e-signature system datasource. Empty when that system has no row for this opportunity (report section 2, multi-datasource).

objectType.description: A call, email, meeting or note. Edits-only: created only by actions, no source table.

create-lead.description: Create an unassigned lead with status 'new'.
create-lead.toolDescription: Create a new unassigned sales lead.

assign-lead.description: Assign a new lead to a sales rep if the rep is under their open-lead limit.
assign-lead.toolDescription: Assign a new lead to a sales rep. Fails if the rep already has maxOpenLeads open leads.

convert-lead.description: Turn an assigned lead into an Account, a Contact and an Opportunity.
convert-lead.toolDescription: Convert an assigned lead into an account, contact and opportunity.

advance-opportunity-stage.description: Move an open opportunity to another open stage.

apply-discount.description: Set the discount on an opportunity. 20% or more needs a sales manager.

close-opportunity-won.description: Close a negotiated opportunity that has a signed contract.
close-opportunity-won.toolDescription: Close an opportunity as won. Billing is notified after the commit; check its status before telling the user billing is done.

log-activity.description: Record a call, email, meeting or note against a contact.

add-contact-to-opportunity.description: Link a contact to an opportunity (many-to-many).
